notes.title: New Release - Titan Attacks!, 20% off
notes.notes:
Titan Attacks!, from the studio that brought you Revenge of the Titans, is now available on Steam and is 20% off until February 10th at 10AM!

Battle swarms of alien fighters, bombers and giant boss motherships, over 5 unique worlds and 100 levels of frantic action. Earn bounty money and upgrade your ship with extra cannon, rockets and lasers. Destroy falling wrecks, dodge hurtling asteroids and capture escaping aliens - or blast them from the skies!

notes.title: New Release - Revenge of the Titans
notes.notes:
Revenge of the Titans is now available on Steam and is 10% off!

Stop the relentless march of the Titans from reaching Earth's bases in this mash-up of Real-time Strategy and Tower Defense!

Offer ends March 23rd, 10am Pacific Time.
